+"""Smoke test for PL-03 (risk_report) on the risk.vol_series fake: checks only the output's shape."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import ModuleType
+
+import pytest
+
+import risk.report_pipeline
+from risk import Report, risk_report
+
+ROW_KEYS = {
+    "ticker",
+    "ann_return",
+    "ann_vol",
+    "sharpe",
+    "last_vol",
+    "max_drawdown",
+    "peak_date",
+    "trough_date",
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def fake_vol(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, contract_fake: Callable[[str], ModuleType]) -> None:
+    fake = contract_fake("risk.vol_series")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(risk.report_pipeline, "vol_series", fake.vol_series)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fake_vol")
+def test_risk_report_runs_end_to_end(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    out = tmp_path / "out" / "report.json"
+    report = risk_report("unused.csv", out, window=2)
+    assert isinstance(report, Report)
+    assert report.path == str(out)
+    tickers = [row["ticker"] for row in report.rows]
+    assert len(tickers) == 2
+    assert tickers == sorted(tickers)
+    assert all(set(row) == ROW_KEYS for row in report.rows)
+    assert json.loads(out.read_text()) == {"tickers": [dict(row) for row in report.rows]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fake_vol")
+def test_risk_report_keeps_only_requested_tickers(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    out = tmp_path / "report.json"
+    first = risk_report("unused.csv", out, window=2).rows[0]["ticker"]
+    assert isinstance(first, str)
+    report = risk_report("unused.csv", out, window=2, tickers=[first])
+    assert [row["ticker"] for row in report.rows] == [first]
